> **Heads-up: this version changes the app's identifier.**
> GitHuttBr now ships with its own app identifier. Your settings, tokens and repositories stay where they are.
>
> - **If the automatic update fails**, download this version from [git.huttbr.com](https://git.huttbr.com) and install it by hand.
> - **If that install fails too**, uninstall the current version first (your settings are kept), then install the new one.
> - **On macOS**, the first launch may ask for your password so GitHuttBr can read its saved tokens: choose **Always Allow**.
